scope: Independent native original master and canonical FA56 visual review. No image generation, pixel edits, staging, registration, counters or publication by this reviewer. One starting pose is not a complete exercise conversion.

identityAndNoShorts.evidence: Recognizable bald featureless head, lean white/light-grey anatomical model, fine clinical contours and neutral inherited body shading. Smooth featureless pelvis without shorts, waistband or garment seams; both white trainers intact. Anatomical continuity from torso through pelvis/thighs and from shoulders through forearms is readable.

wholeAnatomyAndProportions.evidence: Whole head, torso, pelvis, both upper/lower legs, shoes, arms and gripping hands are present in one coherent whole-source pose. No severed, grafted or floating limb, gross global scale break or obvious upper/lower-arm mismatch found. Projected lengths are not asserted to be calibrated physical limb lengths.

neutralBraceAndStartingPose.evidence: Kneeling hips broadly over knee support, torso inclined forward, arms long with hands under/slightly forward of shoulders in the oblique projection. Posterior trunk is continuous and neutral, without an obvious lumbar sag or exaggerated arch. Pelvic brace/tuck reads plausibly; static art cannot prove muscular contraction.

kneePadSupport.evidence: Both knees meet the top of one low pad, with lower legs extending behind. Near and far knee contacts are visibly supported; no dangling knee or intervening floor gap is visible. Image-y differences between floor objects are perspective, not evidence of unequal ground depth.

twoHandGrips.evidence: Both closed fists wrap the two ends of the same horizontal-in-space wheel axle. Near shaft end, hub and far shaft end are continuous through the wheel; no extra handle, detached grip or hand floating above an axle is visible.

wheelGroundAndOrdinaryEquipment.evidence: One modest ordinary broad-tread wheel with a central hub/axle and two grips, plus one knee pad. Wheel bottom touches the visible shadowed floor with no obvious unsupported gap. Oblique wheel face/tread projection and axle-end height difference are coherent. No calibration/no-slip roll claim is made.

cameraAndRolloutRoom.evidence: Fixed front-side oblique view exposes both hands, both knees and wheel contact. Starting figure/equipment occupies roughly x65-925, leaving substantial empty room toward screen right for controlled rollout. A later extended source must still demonstrate whole-body framing, contact and neutral spine; this margin alone does not approve it.

colourAndMuscleFields.observedRoles: Abdominal/lateral core is visually stronger purple; both deltoid caps and upper lateral/back region are lighter purple. Legs, chest, forearms, pelvis, shoes and wheel remain neutral.
colourAndMuscleFields.finishNeeded: Original muscle fields contain graded purple shading and do not yet establish exact flat #7B72E9 primary/#9590E0 secondary ownership and fine inherited neutral contours. Do not treat this original palette as a final accepted field pass.

boundaryFinding.evidence: The near posterior upper-arm/lateral-back purple patch below/behind the deltoid could include posterior upper-arm tissue rather than only the requested Lats. Native oblique overlap makes the precise ownership less certain. Review that source contour region separately; do not indiscriminately classify every purple patch as Lats or extend muscle fill across an arm boundary. Any correction must stay colour/field-only and preserve anatomy, contacts and neutral pixels.
boundaryFinding.coordinateLimit: Region is a visual inspection ROI, not an exact tissue segmentation or generation anchor.

notYetProven: A matching intermediate and controlled extended whole-athlete source with preserved model, pad/knee support and wheel geometry
Full rollout and return scope, neutral spine through range and appropriate wheel displacement
Six distinct beat paths with honest source reuse and actual native playback/loop
Mobile light/dark, editable/provenance/project checks and merge
decision: Use this intact no-shorts master provisionally for adjacent source authoring. Do not regenerate or alter its anatomy merely for colour mismatch. Reassess actual generated adjacent sources before further states; no sequence acceptance or completion credit from this one pose.
